summary: Iteration 121: Comprehensive regression testing of integration modules (CIPP, UniFi Site Manager, UniFi Controllers, Suped DMARC, Hudu KB). All 37 backend tests PASSED. Frontend testing verified all integration pages render correctly with proper empty/not-configured states.
critical_code_review_comments: CIPP: /api/cipp/status returns all expected fields (configured, base_url, api_key_preview, last_test_status, last_synced_at)
CIPP: /api/cipp/summary, /api/cipp/linked-clients, /api/cipp/digests all return 200 without 500 errors when not configured
CIPP: /api/cipp/hygiene-digest returns {configured:false} when CIPP not configured - correct behavior
CIPP: /api/clients/{id}/cipp-hygiene returns {linked:false} for unlinked client - correct behavior
UniFi Site Manager: /api/unifi/status, /api/unifi/summary, /api/unifi/linked-clients all work without 500 when unconfigured
UniFi Site Manager: /api/unifi/_debug/raw?path=devices and ?path=sites return structured response with configured field
UniFi Controllers: Full CRUD tested - POST creates with all fields (name, controller_url, api_key, network_site_id, verify_tls), PUT updates, DELETE removes
UniFi Controllers: /api/unifi/controllers/{id}/test fails gracefully on fake URL (returns success:false)
UniFi Controllers: /api/unifi/controllers/{id}/summary returns expected structure with controller, stats, devices, clients fields
UniFi Controllers: /api/unifi/controllers/{id}/devices, /clients, /sites return 502 gracefully on unreachable controller
Suped: /api/suped/services returns exactly 6 services with correct keys
Suped: /api/suped/compliance-dashboard returns all expected fields (overall_score, fully_protected, partially_protected, unprotected, total_clients, client_details, service_coverage, at_risk)
Suped: /api/clients/{id}/subscriptions GET returns default structure, PUT saves suped_org_id + services correctly
HUDU CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED: /api/hudu/summary ALWAYS returns stats object with 6 numeric keys (companies, articles, assets, procedures, websites, passwords) - never null/undefined
Hudu: /api/hudu/summary responds fast (cache-backed), force=true refreshes cache
Hudu: /api/hudu/sync returns summary field after import
All integration endpoints require authentication (return 401/403 without token)
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_Controller_121 for UniFi Controllers CRUD tests. Created and cleaned up TEST_org_121 for client subscriptions tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All integration modules working correctly. Key findings: 1) CIPP page renders with Hygiene Digest tab, shows 'not configured' state correctly. 2) UniFi Command Center renders with 3 tabs (Cloud Sites, Controllers live, Linked Clients), shows 'not configured' state with Configure UniFi link. 3) Settings page has UniFi card with both Site Manager section AND Direct Site Controllers (UnifiControllersManager) section with Add controller dialog containing all required fields. 4) Hudu Command Center renders with metric strip showing numbers (0 when not configured), Sync now button visible. 5) Suped Command Center renders with Overview, All Clients, DMARC records tabs and service coverage metrics. 6) CRITICAL: Hudu summary bug FIXED - /api/hudu/summary now always returns stats object with 6 numeric keys from db.settings type='hudu_summary_cache'.
